Can only be implemented as core.

#### Short Q&A:

**Q:** Does this not affect discoverability?
**A:** The feature needs to appear in the documentation, but custom command line arguments are game specific, so it has no relation to discoverability.

**Q:** What if I add an editor plugin, can I make it appear on the command line?
**A:** No, when running godot --help, the major part of the engine is not initialized, so plugins won't load anyway. 

**Q:** Is it really too difficult to parse all arguments together, engine and command line?
**A:** Yes, because otherwise error reporting becomes very difficult (unknown options, malformed arguments, or even guessing the amount of arguments following a `--option <args>` syntax. Separating between engine and editor/game options is the cleanest possible way to do and standard in Unixes for this task.

title: Separate command line arguments from engine and game/editor
